content.summary: Accept within the domain-expert remit. I read the final manuscript afresh and verified its digest, the canonical snapshot digest and the three inspected source-module digests. The final statements match their formal interfaces and retain the mathematical limitations. No unresolved domain finding or required revision remains.

checks.method: Compared Theorems 3–4 and definitions with SupportFinish53 and the expanded literal_support53 interface.
checks.observation: The theorem bounds the actual union of 28 distinct four-sets, assuming intersection and absence of three distinct petals with equal pairwise intersections, including empty core. It has arbitrary Type u and no finite ambient-type or I(27) premise. Degree selection, degree caps and numerical inequalities are derived internally, as previously inspected.

checks.scope: Finite equivalence and limits of the contribution
checks.method: Re-read the exact-size subfamily construction, Fin 53 equivalence and final exclusion/optimality paragraphs.
checks.observation: The larger-family premise is exactly cardinality greater than 27; selection preserves all hypotheses and support53 permits injective relabeling. The named I(27) predicate's Type scope and the reduction's Type-u scope are explicitly distinguished. Neither the equivalence nor the sensitivity diagnostic proves obstruction exclusion, realizes a maximizing tuple, or establishes optimality of capacity 53. The final text makes none of those claims.
